You can grab a 12-pack of Zepath’s rechargeable AA batteries for just $24
items.summary:
It’s time to say goodbye to your multi-headed USB-C cable. | Photo: Sean Hollister / The Verge	

If you’re picking up any gifts that require AA batteries, it’s not a bad idea to buy a set you can keep using long after the holidays. Thankfully, you can currently get a 12-pack of Zepath’s rechargeable 3,000mWh AAs on Amazon with a charger for $23.99 ($8 off) for Black Friday, which is a new low. If you don’t need as many, Amazon is also selling an eight-pack under a different name for just $15.99 ($4 off).
Zepath USB-C Li-ion AA Batteries

Where to Buy:

 $19.99 $15.99 at Amazon (8-pack, 3000mWh)
 $31.99 $23.99 at Amazon (12-pack, 3000mWh)

My colleague Sean Hollister tested Zepath’s higher-capacity 3,600mWh batteries against competing lithium-ion AAs in April, and he picked them as his top choice. In his tests, they even outlasted Panasonic’s pricier Eneloop Pros in both a Game Boy Advance and a high-powered flashlight. Zepath also says the batteries deliver a steady 1.5V until they’re nearly empty and hold their charge well when not in use.
The best part about Zepath’s rechargeables, though, is how you charge them. Instead of relying on a multi-headed USB-C cable that plugs into each cell, you simply drop them into the included clamshell charging case, like a pair of AirPods or a similar set of wireless earbuds. The case also charges via USB-C, so you can top off eight batteries at once with a single connection in about two and a half hours.

items.title: Apple’s AirPods Pro 3 are a whopping $100 off for Black Friday
items.summary:
AirPods Pro 3 | Photo: Amelia Holowaty Krales / The Verge	

The AirPods Pro 3 are cheaper than ever. Despite receiving an early discount last week, Apple’s latest flagship wireless earbuds are still on sale for just $149 at Amazon, Best Buy, and Walmart. They originally sold for $249, but are commonly available for $199 outside major deal events. The best price that we’ve previously seen was $169.
It’s a weird situation that, right now, the feature-packed AirPods Pro 3 are the same price as the newer (but less impressive) AirPods 5, which include a wireless charging case. The Pro 3 deliver considerably more bang for your buck.
AirPods Pro 3

Where to Buy:

 $249 $149 at Amazon
 $249 $149 at Walmart
 $249 $149.99 at Best Buy

This model is Apple’s best-sounding, longest-lasting AirPods, and they ship with five silicone ear tips. Compared to the second-gen AirPod Pro, these offer better water resistance (IP57 versus IP54), longer battery life per charge (eight hours versus six), improved noise cancellation, and heart rate sensing through built-in sensors. The case also has Apple’s second-gen Ultra Wideband chip in the case.
Read our full AirPods Pro 3 review.

Buying a laptop right now is rough, but these Black Friday deals help
items.summary:
Affordable laptops are even more affordable right now. | Photo: Antonio G. Di Benedetto / The Verge	

Laptop prices have been a hot-button topic all year long thanks to RAMageddon. We’ve seen existing models get more expensive and new models arrive at higher prices than last-gen — sometimes with lower specs, too. 2026 in general has been a bad time to buy a computer. But thankfully, Black Friday can offer a tiny bit of respite.
If the computer you currently use is working well for you, good. Happy for you. But if you’re in the market for something more powerful, bigger, smaller, thinner, etc. — and you prefer new over used — you can currently save some decent dough on MacBooks, Windows notebooks, and gaming laptops.
The big, multi-hundred-dollar savings are typically reserved for higher-end models with bigger specs, like Windows models running Nvidia’s new Arm-based RTX Spark platform — which are getting their first major discounts. More budget-friendly laptops are also receiving decent discounts right now, though, including the MacBook Neo. The current $100 discount on Apple’s budget laptop might seem like small potatoes considering it’s just a return to its original price, but it’s the best you can do for now (if you can’t hold out for a rumored new one in 2027).
As always, the deals below are for laptops we’ve reviewed or tested firsthand in some way at The Verge — either that exact model or a similar one we expect to be equally good. There are many laptops out there and myriad deals running now through Cyber Monday, but if any of these fit your needs, you can’t go wrong.

Apple’s most affordable laptop uses the same A18 Pro chip found in the iPhone 16 Pro. It features a vibrant 13-inch display, surprisingly good speakers, and 8GB of RAM, making it a solid option for students and anyone who needs a laptop for everyday tasks. Read our review.

items.title: The absolute best Black Friday deals we’ve found (so far)
items.summary:
This year’s Black Friday deals have launched in waves over the past several weeks, but now the floodgates have officially opened. You can now take advantage of the lowest prices we’ve seen in-store and online for video games, wireless earbuds, TVs, e-readers, robot vacuums, and so much more. We can’t guarantee a deal you’ve had your eye on will last through Cyber Monday; however, if prior years are any indication, most will stick around through the long holiday weekend.
As usual, we sorted through thousands of deals to find the ones truly worth sharing, with an eye for the products and services we’ve tested here at The Verge. With prices up across multiple categories due to RAMageddon, some deals may not seem as big as in prior years. For example, Apple’s latest MacBook Air recently fell to its pre-price hike level for the first time since July. That’s a deal to us, and several other discounts are taking a similar shape. We’ll provide context when possible and keep this post updated throughout the day.
AirPods Pro 3
Apple’s AirPods Pro 3 deliver the best noise cancellation and sound quality of any AirPods yet, along with a more comfortable, secure fit and improved water resistance. They also feature built-in heart rate tracking for workouts and support live translations for a handful of languages. Read our review.

items.title: The Oura Ring 5 just got its biggest discount ever for Black Friday
items.summary:
The Oura Ring 5 is smaller and more comfortable to wear than the Ring 4 (surprise, surprise). | Photo: Amelia Holowaty Krales / The Verge	

If you’ve been curious about smart rings but have been put off by their high price tags, Black Friday is a good time to consider giving one a try. That’s because the Oura Ring 5, which we consider the best smart ring you can buy, has dropped to an all-time low of $299 ($100 off) at Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, and Oura’s online storefront for Black Friday.
Oura Ring 5

Where to Buy:

 $399 $299 at Amazon
 $399 $299 at Walmart
 $399 $299 at Best Buy

Compared to the Ring 4, the Oura Ring 5 offers a thinner, lighter, and more durable design that’s more comfortable to wear throughout the day and while sleeping. Like its predecessor, it can track your sleep, activity, heart rate, and other health metrics, giving you insights into your overall well-being without requiring you to constantly check a screen. It also offers roughly the same battery life and sensors as the prior model, though its new charging case supports wireless charging. (Unfortunately, the case is currently sold separately for $99.)
Oura has also introduced several new software features, including Health Radar, which looks for potentially significant changes in your health. You can also import medical lab results, track GLP-1 medications, and access AI-assisted medical guidance through Oura’s partnership with Counsel Health. My colleague Victoria Song appreciated how the latter makes it easier to connect with an actual doctor, though she found it better suited for quick medical questions than more serious health concerns.
However, none of these software features are exclusive to the Ring 5, and you’ll still need a $5.99 monthly Oura membership to access most of its health insights. Given how similar the two generations are, we wouldn’t recommend upgrading if you already own a Ring 4. But if you’re new to smart rings, the current discount makes Oura’s latest model much more attractive, especially since it’s only $50 more than the Ring 4’s starting price.
Read our full Oura Ring 5 review.

items.title: The SE 3 is the Apple Watch most people should buy on Black Friday
items.summary:
The SE 3 adds an always-on display to Apple’s budget-friendly wearable. | Photo: Amelia Holowaty Krales / The Verge	

During Black Friday, the Apple Watch SE 3 is on sale in the 40mm / GPS configuration at Amazon, Walmart, and Target starting around $179 ($70 off), $20 less than its previous lowest price. The 44mm variant, meanwhile, is on sale at Amazon, Walmart, and Target starting at around $209 (also $70 off), also beating its previous low by $20.
Apple Watch SE 3

Where to Buy:

 $249 $179 at Amazon (40mm, GPS)
 $249 $179 at Walmart (40mm, GPS)
 $279 $209 at Amazon (44mm, GPS)

Despite having launched over a year ago, the Apple Watch SE 3 is still the Apple Watch model we recommend for most people. It includes many of the trademark features of higher-end Apple Watch models like the Series 12, including an always-on display, double-tap and wrist flick gestures, fast-charging, and on-device Siri. The compromise is that the SE 3 lacks some of the more advanced health features found on more expensive models, like blood oxygen and EKG sensing. The battery life also isn’t quite as strong, but if you don’t need as many health-tracking sensors, it’s a much better value, especially at this price.
Read our Apple Watch SE 3 review.
